groups.title: Starter patches
groups.blurb: Every account has these ten from the start: the branches of the army.

groups.title: Rank patches
groups.blurb: One for every rank. Earn XP in battle, win for more, and climb from Recruit to General of the Army.

groups.title: Awards and decorations
groups.blurb: Medals, badges and ribbons. Locked for now.

groups.title: Unit patches
groups.blurb: Company and squadron patches in the style of the Vietnam war, and the battlefield's own units. Locked for now.

insignia.name: Infantry
insignia.blurb: Crossed rifles on infantry blue: the queen of battle.

insignia.name: Armour
insignia.blurb: The three-coloured triangle of the tank arm.

insignia.name: Artillery
insignia.blurb: Crossed cannons in gold on red: the king of battle.

insignia.name: Combat Engineers
insignia.blurb: The castle: they build it, and they blow it up.

insignia.name: Signal Corps
insignia.blurb: Crossed lightning on orange: the voice of command.

insignia.name: Combat Medic
insignia.blurb: A white cross on maroon. Doc, the most welcome man on any battlefield.

insignia.name: Scouts
insignia.blurb: The open eye of reconnaissance.

insignia.name: Paratrooper
insignia.blurb: Canopy and wings: the ones who go in first, from the sky.

insignia.name: Mountain Troops
insignia.blurb: Snow-capped peaks on sky blue, for those who fight uphill.

insignia.name: Naval Infantry
insignia.blurb: The fouled anchor: soldiers of the sea.

insignia.name: Recruit Depot
insignia.blurb: Your first patch. Everyone starts somewhere.

insignia.name: Rifle Range
insignia.blurb: Front sight, squeeze, follow through.

insignia.name: Point Man
insignia.blurb: First in the column, eyes on everything.

insignia.name: Night Watch
insignia.blurb: Two hours on, four off, until dawn.

insignia.name: Fire Team
insignia.blurb: Four men, one team. Bounding overwatch.

insignia.name: Iron Fist
insignia.blurb: Hit hard, hit first.

insignia.name: Bolt Battalion
insignia.blurb: Fast enough to arrive before the thunder.

insignia.name: Grey Wolves
insignia.blurb: They hunt in packs.

insignia.name: River Guard
insignia.blurb: Holding the crossings since the first bridge.

insignia.name: Thunder Company
insignia.blurb: You'll hear them coming. Too late.

insignia.name: Mustangs
insignia.blurb: A Troop rides again.

insignia.name: Sand Vipers
insignia.blurb: Desert patrol. Mind where you step.

insignia.name: Iron Dragoons
insignia.blurb: Mounted infantry: they ride to the fight and fight on foot.

insignia.name: Pathfinders
insignia.blurb: They light the way for everyone else.

insignia.name: Hellcats
insignia.blurb: C Company, and proud of the claw marks.

insignia.name: Mountain Raiders
insignia.blurb: The tab says it all.

insignia.name: Air Assault
insignia.blurb: Forty men down in a hot landing zone in forty seconds.

insignia.name: Night Owls
insignia.blurb: They own the dark.

insignia.name: Black Scorpions
insignia.blurb: Desert warfare school graduates.

insignia.name: Storm Riders
insignia.blurb: Jump into the storm, land in the fight.

insignia.name: Dawn Eagles
insignia.blurb: First light, first strike.

insignia.name: Checkmate
insignia.blurb: Every move planned, every piece in play.

insignia.name: Four Winds
insignia.blurb: Any direction, any distance.

insignia.name: Iron Bears
insignia.blurb: Slow to anger. Impossible to stop.

insignia.name: Firebrands
insignia.blurb: Assault pioneers with a flamethrower habit.

insignia.name: Sky Cavalry
insignia.blurb: The horses have rotors now.

insignia.name: Hunter Killers
insignia.blurb: One finds, the other fixes. Both kill.

insignia.name: Jet Wing
insignia.blurb: Fast movers, on call.

insignia.name: Thunderbolts
insignia.blurb: Close air support with a temper.

insignia.name: Eagle Flight
insignia.blurb: Three stars over the eagle: the flight that leads.

insignia.name: Commandos
insignia.blurb: The arrowhead and the fighting knife.

insignia.name: Shadow Company
insignia.blurb: Officially, they were never there.

insignia.name: Black Arrows
insignia.blurb: Deep strike, no warning.

insignia.name: Frogmen
insignia.blurb: In from the sea, under it.

insignia.name: Snake Eaters
insignia.blurb: Long range recon. They live off the jungle.

insignia.name: Thunder Run
insignia.blurb: Straight down the highway at forty miles an hour.

insignia.name: Steel Rain
insignia.blurb: The guns that answer every call for fire.

insignia.name: Juggernaut
insignia.blurb: Nothing on the field can stop it.

insignia.name: The Dukes
insignia.blurb: Old regiment, older traditions.

insignia.name: Line Breakers
insignia.blurb: When the line won't move, they move it.

insignia.name: Laurel Guard
insignia.blurb: Gold bullion on navy: honour earned.

insignia.name: Crown Command
insignia.blurb: The regiment's colours, and its crown.

insignia.name: Order of the Sword
insignia.blurb: Silver blade, golden laurel.

insignia.name: Silver Eagle
insignia.blurb: The colonel's eagle, spread in silver.

insignia.name: Phoenix Brigade
insignia.blurb: Rebuilt from the ashes, twice.

insignia.name: Brigade Command
insignia.blurb: One star. A brigade answers to you.

insignia.name: Division Command
insignia.blurb: Two stars and the laurel.

insignia.name: Corps Command
insignia.blurb: Three stars. Divisions move when you speak.

insignia.name: Army Command
insignia.blurb: Four stars over the golden eagle.

insignia.name: Supreme Command
insignia.blurb: Five stars in a ring. General of the Army: there is no higher rank.

insignia.name: Valor Cross
insignia.blurb: For extraordinary heroism in combat.

insignia.name: Star of Gallantry
insignia.blurb: For gallantry in action against an enemy.

insignia.name: Silver Valor Star
insignia.blurb: Third highest for valour, and worn proudly.

insignia.name: Bronze Service Star
insignia.blurb: For meritorious service in a combat zone.

insignia.name: Wounded in Action
insignia.blurb: Bled for it. Nobody wants this one.

insignia.name: Distinguished Service
insignia.blurb: For exceptional service in a position of great responsibility.

insignia.name: Air Valor Medal
insignia.blurb: For valour in aerial flight.

insignia.name: Steadfast Service
insignia.blurb: Three years of exemplary conduct. Allegedly.

insignia.name: Jungle Campaign
insignia.blurb: Served in the jungle war.

insignia.name: Desert Campaign
insignia.blurb: Served in the desert war.

insignia.name: Arctic Service
insignia.blurb: Cold enough to freeze the oil in the guns.

insignia.name: River Patrol
insignia.blurb: Brown water navy: the boats on the rivers.

insignia.name: Delta Campaign
insignia.blurb: The paddies and canals of the delta.

insignia.name: Mountain Campaign
insignia.blurb: Fought along the ridgelines.

insignia.name: Order of the Iron Wolf
insignia.blurb: For leading from the front.

insignia.name: Legion of the Laurel
insignia.blurb: For a career of outstanding service.

insignia.name: Lifesaving Medal
insignia.blurb: For saving a life at the risk of one's own.

insignia.name: Airborne Assault
insignia.blurb: For a combat jump.

insignia.name: Combat Aviation Cross
insignia.blurb: For heroism while flying.

insignia.name: Long Service
insignia.blurb: Twenty years in uniform.

insignia.name: Supreme Valor Medal
insignia.blurb: The highest award for valour. Few live to wear it.

insignia.name: Sea Valor Cross
insignia.blurb: For heroism at sea.

insignia.name: Prisoner of War
insignia.blurb: For those who were held, and came home.

insignia.name: Expeditionary Medal
insignia.blurb: Wherever they were sent.

insignia.name: Coalition Service
insignia.blurb: Served with the Coalition.

insignia.name: Jump Wings
insignia.blurb: Five jumps from a perfectly good aircraft.

insignia.name: Senior Jump Wings
insignia.blurb: Thirty jumps, and a star for the trouble.

insignia.name: Master Jump Wings
insignia.blurb: Sixty-five jumps. The wreath says master.

insignia.name: Aviator Wings
insignia.blurb: Rated to fly.

insignia.name: Combat Rifleman
insignia.blurb: The rifle on blue, in the laurel: under fire as an infantryman.

insignia.name: Combat Medic Badge
insignia.blurb: Treated the wounded under fire.

insignia.name: Expert Marksman
insignia.blurb: Forty of forty at the range.

insignia.name: Scout Sniper
insignia.blurb: One shot.

insignia.name: Bomb Disposal
insignia.blurb: Initial success or total failure.

insignia.name: Air Assault Badge
insignia.blurb: Rappel, sling load, repeat.

insignia.name: Pathfinder Badge
insignia.blurb: The torch and the wings: first on the drop zone.

insignia.name: Combat Diver
insignia.blurb: Qualified to go in under water.

insignia.name: Mountain Warfare
insignia.blurb: Qualified on rock, ice and snow.

insignia.name: Raider Tab
insignia.blurb: Sixty days of the hardest course in the army.

insignia.name: Sapper Tab
insignia.blurb: Combat engineers who lead the way.

insignia.name: Commando Badge
insignia.blurb: The winged dagger.

insignia.name: Tanker Badge
insignia.blurb: Qualified in armour, and under fire in it.

insignia.name: Gunnery Badge
insignia.blurb: Master of the guns.

insignia.name: Signal Badge
insignia.blurb: Kept the net up when it mattered.

insignia.name: Driver and Mechanic
insignia.blurb: Ten thousand miles without an accident.

insignia.name: Campaign Ribbons
insignia.blurb: Six campaigns, worn on the chest.

insignia.name: Unit Citation
insignia.blurb: For the unit, not the man: everyone who was there.

insignia.name: Service Ribbons
insignia.blurb: A career's worth of service.

insignia.name: Veteran's Rack
insignia.blurb: Stars on the ribbons: more than one tour.

insignia.name: Hero's Rack
insignia.blurb: Twelve ribbons, top row first. You'd want to hear the stories.

insignia.name: Snake Pit
insignia.blurb: First Platoon's hootch, and its pet.

insignia.name: Gunslingers
insignia.blurb: Gunship platoon. Rockets and miniguns on call.

insignia.name: Dustoff
insignia.blurb: Medevac. They come in under fire for you.

insignia.name: Night Hawks
insignia.blurb: Searchlight and minigun, hunting after dark.

insignia.name: River Rats
insignia.blurb: Patrol boats on the brown water.

insignia.name: Jungle Kings
insignia.blurb: Crowned by the jungle, and they earned it.

insignia.name: Death Dealers
insignia.blurb: Ace of spades, left on the trail.

insignia.name: Magic Dragon
insignia.blurb: The gunship that breathes fire from the night sky.

insignia.name: Wolfpack
insignia.blurb: B Company runs together.

insignia.name: Bat Company
insignia.blurb: Night ambushes, every night.

insignia.name: Tunnel Rats
insignia.blurb: A torch, a pistol, and a hole in the ground.

insignia.name: Sky Raiders
insignia.blurb: They drop in uninvited.

insignia.name: Delta Devils
insignia.blurb: Fire and the fork, in the paddies.

insignia.name: Mud Bulls
insignia.blurb: Mechanized infantry, up to the axles.

insignia.name: Paddy Raiders
insignia.blurb: Wet feet, every day.

insignia.name: Hill Fighters
insignia.blurb: Took the hill. Took it again.

insignia.name: Firebase
insignia.blurb: Sandbags, guns, and a long night.

insignia.name: Phantoms
insignia.blurb: Recon you never see.

insignia.name: Reapers
insignia.blurb: Assault company. Harvest season.

insignia.name: Lucky Aces
insignia.blurb: Dealt from the top of the deck.

insignia.name: Blue Thunder
insignia.blurb: Lift company: they carry everyone else.

insignia.name: Warlords
insignia.blurb: The crown and the swords: command of the field.

insignia.name: Sharks
insignia.blurb: Painted teeth on the nose of every gunship.

insignia.name: Sidewinders
insignia.blurb: Strike fast, strike from the side.

insignia.name: Firestorm
insignia.blurb: When they call in the big stuff.

insignia.name: Black Cats
insignia.blurb: Bad luck, for somebody.

insignia.name: Mad Bulls
insignia.blurb: Charge first, ask later.

insignia.name: Iron Eagles
insignia.blurb: Steel-grey and sharp-eyed.

insignia.name: Bandits
insignia.blurb: Recon team. They steal the enemy's secrets.

insignia.name: Sea Wolves
insignia.blurb: Helicopters over the river mouths.

insignia.name: Swamp Foxes
insignia.blurb: Scouts. Cunning, quick, and wet.

insignia.name: Monsoon
insignia.blurb: They fight in the rain, because it always rains.

insignia.name: Hurricane Battery
insignia.blurb: Six guns, one storm.

insignia.name: Road Runners
insignia.blurb: Armoured cavalry: the convoys get through.

insignia.name: Tomahawks
insignia.blurb: Strike company. Close and personal.

insignia.name: Diamondbacks
insignia.blurb: Rattle before they strike. Sometimes.

insignia.name: Scorpions
insignia.blurb: Desert squadron, sting in the tail.

insignia.name: Bomb Squad
insignia.blurb: If you see them running, keep up.

insignia.name: Eyes Forward
insignia.blurb: Forward observers: the artillery's eyes.

insignia.name: Coalition Armour
insignia.blurb: The Coalition's tank battalions.

insignia.name: Coalition Air Wing
insignia.blurb: The Coalition's helicopters: lift, attack, rescue.

insignia.name: Rebel Militia
insignia.blurb: Farmers by day.

insignia.name: Technicals
insignia.blurb: A pickup truck and a heavy machine gun.

insignia.name: Drone Hunters
insignia.blurb: Every FPV drone has a hunter.

insignia.name: Rebel Sappers
insignia.blurb: They dig under the town, and leave surprises.

insignia.name: Harbor Patrol
insignia.blurb: Keeping the port open.

insignia.name: Bridgehead
insignia.blurb: Operation Broken Crossing: take the bridge and hold it.

insignia.name: Kingpin
insignia.blurb: Operation Silent Gate: one night, one target.

insignia.name: Night Raiders
insignia.blurb: In under the moon, out before dawn.

insignia.name: Last Stand
insignia.blurb: Surrounded. Still here.
